## 問題
2025 年第二季所有物流商合計的平均配送天數？

## 回答 A
最終答案: 2.91
採用的定義與依據: 以 shipments.shipped_ts 落在 2025-04-01 至 2025-06-30 定義第二季，只計入已送達（delivered_ts 非空）的 9947 筆，配送天數為 delivered_ts 減 shipped_ts 的天數，跨 4 家物流商合併平均。未送達的 1181 筆排除；資料無負值或時間格式異常。
SQL 1: SELECT carrier, shipped_ts, delivered_ts FROM shipments ORDER BY shipment_id LIMIT 20
  結果: {'columns': ['carrier', 'shipped_ts', 'delivered_ts'], 'rows': [['post', '2025-05-29 05:32:55', '2025-06-03 18:32:55'], ['blackcat', '2025-06-03 17:04:51', '2025-06-06 13:04:51'], ['hct', '2025-09-28 09:46:07', '2025-09-29 19:46:07'], ['blackcat', '2025-04-12 17:13:13', '2025-04-14 18:13:13'], ['bla
SQL 2: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_delivered_excluded, SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(delivered_ts) < julianday(shipped_ts) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_rows FROM shipments WHERE shipped_ts >= '2025-04-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-07-01' AND delivered_ts IS NOT NULL
  結果: {'columns': ['n', 'avg_delivery_days', 'null_delivered_excluded', 'negative_rows'], 'rows': [[9947, 2.91, 0, 0]], 'truncated': False}
SQL 3: ["SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_q2, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS undelivered_q2 FROM shipments WHERE shipped_ts >= '2025-04-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-07-01'", "SELECT COUNT(*) AS bad_format FROM shipments WHERE (shipped_ts IS NOT NULL AND length(shipped_ts) <> 19) OR (delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND length(delivered_ts) <> 19)"]
  結果: [{'query': "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_q2, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS undelivered_q2 FROM shipments WHERE shipped_ts >= '2025-04-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-07-01'", 'columns': ['total_q2', 'undelivered_q2'], 'rows': [[11128, 1181]], 'truncated': False}, {'query': 'SELECT 
SQL 4: SELECT MIN(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)) AS min_days, MAX(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)) AS max_days, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT carrier) AS carriers FROM shipments WHERE shipped_ts >= '2025-04-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-07-01' AND delivered_ts IS NOT NULL
  結果: {'columns': ['min_days', 'max_days', 'distinct_orders', 'n', 'carriers'], 'rows': [[0.625, 7.083333333488554, 9947, 9947, 4]], 'truncated': False}

## 回答 B
最終答案: 2.91
採用的定義與依據: 配送天數採送達時間減出貨時間（以天計、可含小數），只計 delivered_ts 不為空的出貨。期間依訂單成立時間 orders.order_ts（UTC）換算為台北時間（+8 小時）後歸屬 2025-04-01 至 2025-06-30，所有物流商合併計算；共 9921 筆，無負值。
SQL 1: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_ts, s.shipped_ts, s.delivered_ts FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL LIMIT 5
  結果: {'columns': ['order_id', 'order_ts', 'shipped_ts', 'delivered_ts'], 'rows': [[1, '2025-05-27 02:32:55', '2025-05-29 05:32:55', '2025-06-03 18:32:55'], [2, '2025-06-01 06:04:51', '2025-06-03 17:04:51', '2025-06-06 13:04:51'], [3, '2025-09-27 08:46:07', '2025-09-28 09:46:07', '2025-09-29 19:46:07'], [
SQL 2: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(julianday(s.delivered_ts) - julianday(s.shipped_ts)), 2) AS avg_days, SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(s.delivered_ts) < julianday(s.shipped_ts) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') >= '2025-04-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  結果: {'columns': ['n', 'avg_days', 'negative'], 'rows': [[9921, 2.91, 0]], 'truncated': False}

response:
題目要比較兩個回答。兩者答案都是 2.91。A 用 shipped_ts 定義季度、未做時區轉換；B 用 order_ts 並做 UTC+8 換算。

問題問的是「第二季物流配送」，以出貨時間界定期間較貼近物流語意。B 依訂單成立時間歸屬，可說是業務慣例，而且有處理時區；但 B 沒有交代資料是 UTC 的依據。A 則沒處理時區，而 shipped_ts 可能也是 UTC。

A 有做品質檢查：排除了 1181 筆未送達、檢查格式、確認最小／最大值、確認 4 家物流商。驗證比較完整，也更貼近問題中的物流商面向。

整體來看 A 略勝，兩者都沒有嚴重錯誤。

{"winner": "A", "reason": "兩者答案相同，但 A 以出貨時間界定季度更貼近物流語意，且完整驗證了未送達排除、格式、極值與物流商數；B 改用訂單時間並做未經佐證的時區換算，檢查也較少", "critical_error": false}
